items.title: Anthropic Claude Sonnet 5.5 and Claude Opus 5.5 are now available on Kiro in AWS GovCloud (US)
items.blurb: Two new Anthropic models are now available in the Kiro IDE and CLI for the AWS GovCloud (US) Regions. Claude Opus 5.5 is Anthropic's most capable Opus model yet and a step up from Opus 5 on long-running agentic coding work.

items.title: Amazon Connect Customer now provides automated checks to improve performance evaluation forms
items.blurb: Amazon Connect Customer now suggests changes to performance evaluation forms that improve the accuracy of evaluations automatically filled by AI.

items.title: Amazon S3 Vectors metadata pre-filtering is now available in AWS GovCloud (US) Regions
items.blurb: Amazon S3 Vectors metadata pre-filtering is now available in the AWS GovCloud (US-East) and AWS GovCloud (US-West) Regions.

items.title: Android Bench 2 Adds Support for Long-Horizon Tasks, Agentic Evaluation, and Continuous Scoring
items.blurb: Google has released Android Bench 2.0, a major update to its benchmark framework for evaluating AI models and agents on Android development tasks.

items.title: Olson and Söderqvist Discuss Valkey’s Evolution and Future Past Caching Use Cases at OSS EU
items.blurb: Valkey is a growing project, launched as a fork of Redis over two years ago, supported by twelve maintainers and nine committee members from various companies.

items.title: HashiCorp Relased Terraform Google Cloud Provider 8.0 in General Availability
items.blurb: HashiCorp has announced the general availability of version 8.0 of the Terraform provider for Google Cloud. The major release updates the default load balancing for two Compute Engine resources.

items.title: OpenAI GPT-6.1 Sol now supports Ultrafast mode on Amazon Bedrock
items.blurb: Today, AWS announces the availability of Ultrafast mode for GPT-6.1 Sol from OpenAI on Amazon Bedrock. Ultrafast mode provides faster inference for workloads where speed matters most.

items.title: AWS Cost Explorer, Budgets, and Dashboards now support Amazon Bedrock product attributes
items.blurb: AWS Cost Explorer, AWS Budgets, and AWS Cost Management Dashboards now let you analyze Amazon Bedrock costs by product attributes, a new dimension that breaks down Bedrock cost by model, model provider, inference type, and feature.

items.title: Amazon RDS for Oracle now supports minor version upgrade prechecks and a new RDS event to help reduce patching downtime
items.blurb: Amazon Relational Database Service (Amazon RDS) for Oracle now lets you run a minor version upgrade precheck yourself, before you start an upgrade or before your scheduled maintenance window.
